records.title: Regent Luxury Cruises - 35% Off, OBC, FREE Land Promo

sailingWindow.rawText: For sailings on or between 11/22/2026 and 12/15/2027

records.promotionDetailsRaw:
In 2027, Regent Seven Seas Cruises® celebrates a remarkable milestone: 35 years of crafting the world's most luxurious voyages. To begin the celebration, we invite you aboard 35 anniversary sailings to some of the most storied destinations in the world. Each voyage features special programming, commemorative gifts and unexpected surprises created just for this milestone. Enjoy Up To 35% Savings, plus a $350 Shipboard Credit per suite, and discover why a Regent voyage is unrivaled.

Reserve by August 31, 2026.

Regent Seven Seas Luxury Cruises - FREE Land Program on Exotics

FREE Pre- or Post-Cruise Land Program. Embark on a voyage unlike any other with Regent Seven Seas Cruises. Enhance your journey with a FREE Pre- or Post-Cruise Land Program on select 2026–2027 Exotic Voyages. With over 15 immersive experiences to choose from, uncover the world’s most iconic destinations in unparalleled style. Whether it’s mastering the art of tango in Buenos Aires, sipping tea in Tokyo or discovering the fascinating traditions of Singapore, each multi-night tour package is thoughtfully curated to deepen your cultural connection.   Offer available on select sailings from November 2026 through March 2027.

BANGKOK, SYDNEY, RIO, ARGENTINA, FIJI, PAPEETE, PANAMA

Reserve by August 31, 2026.
records.agentInstructionsRaw:
35th Anniversary Promotion - applies only to new reservations made between July 16, 2026, through August 31, 2026. Guests will receive savings of up to 35% on select voyages in select suite categories, plus a $175 USD Shipboard Credit per guest, up to $350 USD per suite. Offer is capacity controlled, valid only for residents of the US and Canada who either book directly with Regent Seven Seas Cruises® or through travel advisors located only in the US and Canada. Mention “ANNIVERSARY” at time of booking.

Applicable suite categories are as follows per ship: Seven Seas Prestige, Explorer, Grandeur, Mariner, Splendor: D-H (Concierge & Below), Seven Seas Voyager: A-H (Penthouse & Below)

Shipboard Credits may be used for Regent Choice Shore Excursions, spa treatments, boutique merchandise, Executive Collection private transportation in ports, and Culinary Arts Kitchen and Epicurean Enrichment Studio classes. Shipboard Credits cannot be used for Casino credits. Shipboard Credit is valid only for the cruise booked, and all unused credit will expire at the end of the cruise.

Availability is limited, and restrictions apply — applicable voyages are subject to removal at any time without notice; savings amounts are subject to change. Offer may be withdrawn at any time without prior notice. Offer is combinable with Seven Seas Society Savings, Regent Ambassador Savings, Onboard Savings and Active Standard Consumer Events; however, offer is not combinable with Iconic Explorations, Groups Pricing, Resident Specials and other discount offers. For the list of applicable voyages, please visit www.RSSC.com/Anniversary. For complete Terms & Conditions, please visit www.RSSC.com/legal/terms-conditions.

Offers may not be combinable.

records.promotionDetailsRaw:
PRINCESS CRUISES 2028 EUROPE  EARLY BOOKING BONUS SAVINGS AND SHIPBOARD CREDIT!

Princess Cruises is delighted to unveil our most comprehensive Europe program ever, featuring an extraordinary collection of voyages across Northern Europe, the Mediterranean, and Transatlantic for Summer 2028 — including our extraordinary Pole‑to‑Pole Odyssey, one of the most epic Grand Adventures in our deployment. The full program spans 291 departures on 150 unique itineraries to 118 destinations in 36 countries, and 13 departure ports, making it one of our most diverse and globally appealing European offerings to date.

Offer Details: Up to $500 Instant Savings + Up to $500 Onboard Credit

+ Free Location Upgrade

+ Early Access to Dining Reservations

+ Advanced Access to Embarkation Times

+ $100 Deposits!

Plus! Captain’s Circle members will receive an additional Instant Savings!

Guests 1 & 2 only
Guests with single occupancy will receive single, per guest Instant Savings amount ($25 - $250)
Guests with single occupancy will receive single, per guest OBC amount ($25 - $250)
Guests with single occupancy will receive single, per guest Captain’s Circle Instant Savings amount ($50 - $200)
Free Location Upgrade up to $400 per stateroom

Sailing across six ships — Caribbean Princess, Enchanted Princess, Majestic Princess, Regal Princess, Sky Princess, and Sun Princess — the 2028 season reinforces our leadership across Europe with unmatched variety, iconic marquee ports, and deeper destination access through 32 More Ashore late‑night or overnight stays, including Stockholm, Istanbul, Hamburg, La Spezia (for Florence/Pisa), and Tromsø.

Guests can choose from itineraries ranging from 7 to 53 days, including two maiden calls in Ireland, Galway and Killybegs, along with five land-based cruisetours for even deeper exploration of this remarkable region, plus access to an incredible 101 UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

New Bookings Only deposited: June 2 - October 12, 2028
